title: Master of Education
institution: University of the Witwatersrand (Wits), School of Education
about: The University of the Witwatersrand's Master of Education is offered by dissertation or by coursework and research, with January, April and July intakes. The course finder lists 28 February 2027 as the closing date for the MEd by Dissertation (HRA00).

upskill.name: AI Fundamentals for Education
why: field "Education" (Master of Education, School of Education) → "Explore practical opportunities for AI across teaching, learning, assessment, student support, research, and academic administration."

"offered by dissertation or by coursework and research" → "Identify educational activities that can be enhanced through AI while recognizing where educator expertise, pedagogical judgment, and human interaction remain essential."

card_alt: EduCut Connect card for the Master of Education at the University of the Witwatersrand (Wits), School of Education, in Johannesburg, South Africa, deadline 28 Feb 2027. The photo shows elephant statues in front of the Palace of the Lost City at Sun City, South Africa, not Johannesburg.
